services.name: PostReadMultipleNaturalPerson2
services.description:
The interface reads all fields from the client master that are relevant for a two-person master record for a collection from technical numbers of the client of two-person master records and returns these as a collection.
Transferred client keys need to be available on the database and as main type 2 (multiple private individuals).
This version must be used if ClientParametrisation2.isNoga25Enabled has been set to 1.
This method reads data from BORD if the feature is enabled, the collection is available, and read_from_fcs is not set to true.

Error handling:
This method may return the following gRPC error codes with additional error details:
Disclaimer: When data is read from BORD, only BORD related exceptions and annotation-based invalid argument exceptions will be thrown.

- INVALID_ARGUMENT
  * common.finnova.com.ValidationFailed:
    The transmitted data does not conform to the validation requirements.
    The validation for the reading of clients as two-person master records has failed. The parameter 'clientKeys' contains invalid technical numbers or the transferred client keys are not available in the database as main type 2 (multiple private individuals).
 
@since 7.2024
